title: Dependency linked as a symlink to a local directory
description: package.json declares a `link:` dependency, which installs a symlink instead of a package. Nothing is copied into the artifact, so the dependency resolves to a directory that may not exist or may differ on any other machine.
remediation: Depend on a published version, and keep local linking to development-only overrides that never ship.
limitation: It matches a `link:` dependency, which installs a symlink instead of a package in the parsed package.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
